resources.string: Starting a diagnostic session, restoring DSH or resetting its configuration pauses your normal DSH server and stops running workspace tasks. DSH reconnects when you return. Temporary chats and settings are cleared when the session ends.
Start the installed DSH with temporary settings. In the diagnostic workspace, repair/.dsh contains the original user data and repair/dsh contains the original program.
Start a temporary session from the DSH bundled in the APK if the installed copy is damaged.
Replace the current DSH program with the version bundled in the app. This overwrites changes to the installed program files.
Reset the normal DSH configuration file. Custom model and plugin settings in this file return to their default values.
The last diagnostic session was interrupted.
Temporary session closed. DSH will restart when you leave diagnostics.
Restored. Go back to restart DSH.
The diagnostic page could not open. The temporary session has ended.
The operation did not finish. Try again.
The chats and settings in this temporary session will be cleared.
The diagnostic page could not open. Choose Diagnostic session home in the side navigation to retry.
Saving updates the temporary file. The running session keeps its loaded settings. Ending diagnosis deletes this file.
